articles.title_en: Did Banks Pay Fair Returns to Taxpayers on TARP?
articles.title_cn: 银行是否向纳税人支付了TARP的公平回报？
articles.abstract_en: Financial institutions received investments under the Troubled Asset Relief Program in a bad state of the world but repaid them in a relatively good state. We show that the recipients paid considerably lower returns to taxpayers compared to private‐market securities with similar risk over the same investment horizon, resulting in a subsidy of over $50 billion on the preferred equity investment by the government. Ex‐post renegotiation of contract terms limited the upside gains received by taxpayers in good times and contributed to the subsidy. These findings have important implications for the design and implementation of future bailouts. Our simple methodology for calculating the subsidy can be applied to evaluate the financial costs of other bailouts.
articles.abstract_cn: 金融机构在不利状态下接受了问题资产救助计划下的投资，但在相对有利的状态下偿还了这些投资。我们表明，与相同投资期限内具有类似风险的私人市场证券相比，受助机构向纳税人支付的回报率要低得多，导致政府在优先股投资上获得了超过50亿美元的补贴。合同条款的事后重新谈判限制了纳税人在繁荣时期获得的收益上行空间，并导致了补贴。这些发现对未来救助的设计和实施具有重要意义。我们计算补贴的简单方法可应用于评估其他救助的财务成本。

articles.title_en: Liquidity, Liquidity Everywhere, Not a Drop to Use: Why Flooding Banks with Central Bank Reserves May Not Expand Liquidity
articles.title_cn: 流动性，处处皆是流动性，却无一点可用：为何向银行注入央行准备金可能不会扩大流动性
articles.abstract_en: Central bank balance sheet expansion, through actions like quantitative easing, is run through commercial banks. While this increases liquid central bank reserves held on commercial bank balance sheets, demandable uninsured deposits issued to finance the reserves also increase. Subsequent shrinkage in the central bank balance sheet may entail shrinkage in bank‐held reserves without a commensurate reduction in deposit claims. Furthermore, during episodes of liquidity stress, when many claims on liquidity are called, surplus banks may hoard reserves. As a result, central bank balance sheet expansion may create less additional liquidity than typically thought, and indeed, may increase the probability and severity of episodes of liquidity stress.
articles.abstract_cn: 央行资产负债表的扩张，例如通过量化宽松操作，是通过商业银行进行的。虽然这增加了商业银行资产负债表上持有的流动性央行准备金，但为融资这些准备金而发行的可随时提取的未保险存款也增加了。随后央行资产负债表的收缩可能导致银行持有的准备金减少，而存款债权却没有相应减少。此外，在流动性压力时期，当许多流动性债权被要求兑付时，盈余银行可能会囤积准备金。因此，央行资产负债表的扩张可能创造的额外流动性少于通常认为的水平，并且实际上可能增加流动性压力事件发生的概率和严重程度。

articles.abstract_en: We develop a model of bailout stigma in which accepting a bailout signals a firm's balance‐sheet weakness and reduces its funding prospects. To avoid stigma, high‐quality firms withdraw from subsequent financing after receiving bailouts or refuse bailouts altogether to send a favorable signal. The former leads to a short‐lived stimulation followed by a market freeze even worse than if there were no bailout. The latter revives the funding market, albeit with delay, to the level achievable without any stigma and implements a constrained optimal outcome. A menu of multiple bailout programs compounds bailout stigma and exacerbates the market freeze.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个救助污名模型，在该模型中，接受救助会传递出企业资产负债表疲弱的信号，并降低其融资前景。为避免污名，高质量企业在接受救助后会退出后续融资，或者完全拒绝救助以发出有利信号。前者会导致短暂的刺激，随后市场冻结，甚至比没有救助时更糟。后者则使融资市场复苏，尽管有所延迟，达到无污名情况下可实现的水平，并实现受约束的最优结果。多种救助计划的组合会加剧救助污名，并恶化市场冻结。

articles.title_en: The SOE Premium and Government Support in China's Credit Market
articles.title_cn: 中国信贷市场中的国有企业溢价与政府支持
articles.abstract_en: Studying China's credit market using a structural default model that integrates credit risk, liquidity, and bailout, we document improved price discovery and a deepening divide between state‐owned enterprises (SOEs) and non‐SOEs. Amidst liquidity deterioration, the presence of government bailout helps alleviate the heightened liquidity‐driven default, making SOE bonds more valuable and widening the SOE premium. Meanwhile, the increased importance of government support makes SOEs more sensitive to bailout, while the heightened default risk increases non‐SOEs' sensitivity to credit quality. Examining the real impact, we find severe performance deteriorations of non‐SOEs relative to SOEs, reversing the long‐standing trend of non‐SOEs outperforming SOEs.
articles.abstract_cn: 通过使用一个整合信用风险、流动性和救助的结构性违约模型研究中国信贷市场，我们记录了价格发现的改善以及国有企业与非国有企业之间日益加深的分化。在流动性恶化的情况下，政府救助的存在有助于缓解流动性驱动的违约加剧，使国有企业债券更具价值，并扩大了国有企业溢价。与此同时，政府支持重要性的增加使国有企业对救助更加敏感，而违约风险的上升则提高了非国有企业对信用质量的敏感性。考察实际影响，我们发现非国有企业相对于国有企业的业绩严重恶化，逆转了非国有企业长期表现优于国有企业的趋势。

articles.abstract_en: We propose an approach to measuring the state of the economy via textual analysis of business news. From the full text of 800,000 Wall Street Journal articles for 1984 to 2017, we estimate a topic model that summarizes business news into interpretable topical themes and quantifies the proportion of news attention allocated to each theme over time. News attention closely tracks a wide range of economic activities and can forecast aggregate stock market returns. A text‐augmented vector autoregression demonstrates the large incremental role of news text in forecasting macroeconomic dynamics. We retrieve the narratives that underlie these improvements in market and business cycle forecasts.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种通过商业新闻的文本分析来衡量经济状况的方法。从1984年至2017年800,000篇《华尔街日报》文章的全文来看，我们估计了一个主题模型，该模型将商业新闻总结为可解释的主题，并量化了随时间变化每个主题所获得的新闻关注比例。新闻关注紧密追踪广泛的经济活动，并能预测股票市场的总体回报。一个文本增强的向量自回归模型展示了新闻文本在预测宏观经济动态中的巨大增量作用。我们提取了支撑市场和商业周期预测改进的叙事。

articles.title_cn: 抵押贷款-现金溢价之谜
articles.abstract_en: All‐cash homebuyers account for one‐third of U.S. home purchases between 1980 and 2017. We use multiple data sets and research designs to robustly estimate that mortgaged buyers pay an 11% premium over all‐cash buyers to compensate home sellers for mortgage transaction frictions. A dynamic, representative‐seller model implies only a 3% premium, which would suggest an 8% puzzle. Accounting for heterogeneity in selling conditions explains half of this difference, but a puzzle holds in conditions with high transaction risk. An experimental survey of U.S. homeowners replicates these patterns and suggests that belief distortions can explain the puzzle in these high‐risk states.
articles.abstract_cn: 在1980年至2017年间，全现金购房者占美国房屋购买的三分之一。我们使用多个数据集和研究设计，稳健地估计出抵押贷款购房者比全现金购房者多支付11%的溢价，以补偿房屋卖家因抵押贷款交易摩擦而产生的成本。一个动态的、代表性卖家模型仅暗示3%的溢价，这将表明存在8%的谜团。考虑销售条件的异质性解释了这一差异的一半，但在高交易风险条件下，谜团仍然存在。一项针对美国房主的实验性调查复制了这些模式，并表明信念扭曲可以解释这些高风险状态下的谜团。

articles.title_cn: 对冲基金的未观测绩效
articles.abstract_en: We investigate hedge fund firms’ unobserved performance (UP), measured as the risk‐adjusted return difference between a firm's reported gross return and its portfolio return inferred from its disclosed long‐equity holdings. Firms with high UP outperform those with low UP by 6.36% per annum on a risk‐adjusted basis. UP is negatively associated with a firm's trading costs and positively associated with intraquarter trading in equity positions, derivatives usage, short selling, and confidential holdings. We show that limited investor attention can delay investors’ response to UP and lead to longer lived predictability of fund firm performance.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究对冲基金公司的未观测绩效（UP），该指标衡量为公司报告的总回报与其披露的长期股票持仓所推断出的投资组合回报之间的风险调整后回报差异。UP高的公司每年在风险调整基础上比UP低的公司表现高出6.36%。UP与公司的交易成本负相关，与季度内股票头寸交易、衍生品使用、卖空和保密持仓正相关。我们表明，投资者有限的关注度可能延迟投资者对UP的反应，并导致基金公司绩效的可预测性持续更长时间。

articles.title_en: Do Women Receive Worse Financial Advice?
articles.title_cn: 女性是否获得更差的财务建议？
articles.abstract_en: We arranged for trained undercover men and women to pose as potential clients and visit all 65 local financial advisory firms in Hong Kong. At financial planning firms, but not at securities firms, women were more likely than men to receive advice to buy only individual or only local securities. Female clients who signaled high confidence, high risk tolerance, or a domestic outlook were especially likely to receive this suboptimal advice. Our theoretical model explains these patterns as a result of statistical discrimination interacting with advisors’ incentives. Taste‐based discrimination is unlikely to explain the results.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们安排了训练有素的卧底男性和女性伪装成潜在客户，访问了香港所有65家本地财务咨询公司。在财务规划公司（而非证券公司），女性比男性更有可能收到只购买个人证券或仅本地证券的建议。那些表现出高度自信、高风险承受能力或国内视野的女性客户尤其可能收到这种次优建议。我们的理论模型将这种模式解释为统计性歧视与顾问激励相互作用的结果。基于偏好的歧视不太可能解释这些结果。

articles.title_cn: 金融科技信贷与创业增长
articles.abstract_en: Based on automated credit lines to vendors trading on Alibaba's online retail platform and a discontinuity in the credit decision algorithm, we document that a vendor's access to FinTech credit boosts its sales growth, transaction growth, and the level of customer satisfaction gauged by product, service, and consignment ratings. These effects are more pronounced for vendors characterized by greater information asymmetry about their credit risk and less collateral, which reveals the information advantage of FinTech credit over traditional credit technology.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于阿里巴巴在线零售平台上对商户的自动化信贷额度以及信贷决策算法中的不连续性，我们记录了商户获得金融科技信贷能促进其销售增长、交易增长以及通过产品、服务和寄售评级衡量的客户满意度水平。这些效应对于信用风险信息不对称程度更高且抵押品较少的商户更为显著，这揭示了金融科技信贷相对于传统信贷技术的信息优势。

articles.title_en: Founder‐CEO Compensation and Selection into Venture Capital‐Backed Entrepreneurship
articles.title_cn: 创始人CEO薪酬与风险投资支持型创业的选择
articles.abstract_en: We show theoretically that a critical determinant of the attractiveness of venture capital (VC)‐backed entrepreneurship for high‐earning potential founders is the expected time to develop a startup's initial product. This is because founder‐CEOs' cash compensation increases substantially after product development, alleviating the nondiversifiable risk that founders face at startup birth. Consistent with the model's predictions of where the supply of entrepreneurial talent is likely to be most constrained, we find that technological shocks differentially altering the expected time to product across industries can explain changes in both the rate of entry and characteristics of individuals selecting into VC‐backed entrepreneurship.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们从理论上证明，对于高收入潜力的创始人而言，风险投资支持型创业吸引力的一个关键决定因素是开发初创企业初始产品的预期时间。这是因为创始人CEO的现金薪酬在产品开发后大幅增加，从而缓解了创始人在初创企业诞生时所面临的不可分散风险。与该模型关于创业人才供给最可能受限的预测一致，我们发现，跨行业差异化改变产品预期时间的技术冲击可以解释进入风险投资支持型创业的比率变化以及选择此类创业的个体特征变化。

articles.abstract_en: Twelve trillion dollars are allocated to private market funds that require outside investors to commit to transferring capital on demand. We show within a novel dynamic portfolio allocation model that ex‐ante commitment has large effects on investors' portfolios and welfare, and we quantify those effects. Investors are underallocated to private market funds and are willing to pay a larger premium to adjust the quantity committed than to eliminate other frictions, like timing uncertainty and limited tradability. Perhaps counterintuitively, commitment risk premiums increase with secondary market liquidity, and they do not disappear when investments are spread over many funds.
articles.abstract_cn: 十二万亿美元被配置到私募市场基金，这些基金要求外部投资者承诺按需转移资本。我们在一个新颖的动态投资组合配置模型中表明，事前承诺对投资者的投资组合和福利有重大影响，并量化了这些影响。投资者对私募市场基金的配置不足，并且愿意支付比消除其他摩擦（如时机不确定性和有限可交易性）更高的溢价来调整承诺的数量。也许与直觉相反，承诺风险溢价随着二级市场流动性的增加而上升，并且当投资分散到许多基金时，它们并不会消失。

articles.title_cn: 投资组合驱动的处置效应
articles.abstract_en: The disposition effect for a stock significantly weakens if the portfolio is at a gain, but is large when it is at a loss. We find this portfolio‐driven disposition effect (PDDE) in four independent settings: U.S. and Chinese archival data, as well as U.S. and Chinese experiments. The PDDE is robust to a variety of controls in regression specifications and is not explained by extreme returns, portfolio rebalancing, tax considerations, or investor heterogeneity. Our evidence suggests that investors form mental frames at both the stock and the portfolio levels and that these frames combine to generate the PDDE.
articles.abstract_cn: 当投资组合处于盈利状态时，股票的处置效应显著减弱，但当投资组合处于亏损状态时，处置效应则较大。我们在四个独立的情境中发现了这种投资组合驱动的处置效应（PDDE）：美国和中国的档案数据，以及美国和中国的实验。PDDE在回归规范中对多种控制变量具有稳健性，并且不能由极端回报、投资组合再平衡、税收考虑或投资者异质性来解释。我们的证据表明，投资者在股票和投资组合两个层面形成心理框架，这些框架共同作用产生了PDDE。

articles.title_en: Firm Performance Pay as Insurance against Promotion Risk
articles.title_cn: 企业绩效薪酬作为晋升风险的保险
articles.abstract_en: The prevalence of pay based on risky firm outcomes for nonexecutive workers presents a puzzling departure from conventional contract theory, which predicts insurance provision by the firm. When workers at the same firm compete against each other for promotions, the optimal contract features pay based on firm outcomes as insurance against promotion risk. The model's predictions are consistent with many observed phenomena, such as performance‐based vesting and overvaluation of equity pay by nonexecutive workers. It also generates novel predictions linking a firm's hierarchy to its workers' pay structure.
articles.abstract_cn: 非高管员工基于风险性企业绩效的薪酬普遍存在，这与传统契约理论预测的企业提供保险相悖。当同一企业的员工相互竞争晋升时，最优契约以企业绩效为基础的薪酬作为晋升风险的保险。该模型的预测与许多观察到的现象一致，如基于绩效的归属和非高管员工对股权薪酬的高估。它还产生了将企业层级与员工薪酬结构联系起来的新颖预测。

articles.abstract_en: We examine the timing of returns around the publication of anomaly trading signals. Using a database that captures when information is first publicly released, we show that anomaly returns are concentrated in the first month after information release dates, and these returns decay soon thereafter. We also show that the academic convention of forming portfolios in June underestimates predictability because it uses stale information, which makes some anomalies appear insignificant. In contrast, we show many anomalies do predict returns if portfolios are formed immediately after information releases. Finally, we develop guidance on forming portfolios without using stale information.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了异象交易信号发布前后的收益时机。利用一个捕捉信息首次公开发布时间的数据库，我们表明异象收益集中在信息发布日期后的第一个月，并且这些收益在此后不久便衰减。我们还表明，学术界在六月构建投资组合的惯例因使用过时信息而低估了可预测性，这使得一些异象看似不显著。相反，我们表明如果投资组合在信息发布后立即构建，许多异象确实能预测收益。最后，我们提出了在不使用过时信息的情况下构建投资组合的指导方针。

articles.title_en: Very Noisy Option Prices and Inference Regarding the Volatility Risk Premium
articles.title_cn: 噪声极大的期权价格与波动率风险溢价的推断
articles.abstract_en: The stylized fact that volatility is not priced in individual equity options does not withstand scrutiny. First, we show that the average return of heavily traded deep out‐of‐the‐money call options on stocks is −116 basis points per day. Second, Fama‐MacBeth estimates of the volatility risk premium in stock options are similar to those in S&P 500 Index call options. Third, the mean return of heavily traded delta‐hedged at‐the‐money calls (puts) is −23 (−30) basis points. Fourth, the variance risk premium in stock options is negative. Our analysis highlights the importance of microstructure biases and robustness in empirical work with options.
articles.abstract_cn: 波动率在个股期权中未被定价这一典型化事实经不起推敲。首先，我们表明，交易活跃的深度虚值股票看涨期权的平均日收益率为−116个基点。其次，股票期权中波动率风险溢价的Fama‐MacBeth估计值与标普500指数看涨期权中的估计值相似。第三，交易活跃的德尔塔对冲平值看涨期权（看跌期权）的平均收益率为−23（−30）个基点。第四，股票期权中的方差风险溢价为负。我们的分析强调了微观结构偏差和稳健性在期权实证工作中的重要性。

articles.title_en: On the Magnification of Small Biases in Hiring
articles.title_cn: 论招聘中小偏见的放大效应
articles.abstract_en: We analyze a setting in which a board must hire a chief executive officer (CEO) after exerting effort to learn about the quality of each candidate. Optimal effort is asymmetric, implying asymmetric likelihoods of each candidate being chosen. If the board has an infinitesimal bias in favor of one candidate, it allocates effort to maximize the likelihood of that candidate being chosen. Even when the board's prior is that its preferred candidate is inferior, she may still be chosen most often. A glass ceiling can also arise whereby the tendency to hire favored candidates increases as the importance of the position increases.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了一个董事会必须付出努力了解每位候选人质量后聘请首席执行官（CEO）的情形。最优努力是不对称的，这意味着每位候选人被选中的可能性不对称。如果董事会对某位候选人存在无穷小的偏好，它会分配努力以最大化该候选人被选中的可能性。即使董事会的先验是其偏好的候选人较差，她仍可能最常被选中。玻璃天花板也可能出现，即随着职位重要性的增加，雇用受青睐候选人的倾向也会增加。
